# Chutes

Use `chutes/<model>` with VoltAgent's model router.

## Quick start

```ts
import { Agent } from "@voltagent/core";

const agent = new Agent({
  name: "chutes-agent",
  instructions: "You are a helpful assistant",
  model: "chutes/Nemotron-3-Nano-Omni-30B-TEE",
});
```

## Provider package

`@ai-sdk/openai-compatible`

This provider uses the OpenAI-compatible adapter.

## Default base URL

`https://llm.chutes.ai/v1`

You can override the base URL by setting `CHUTES_BASE_URL`.
